text:
evie.marketing: Draft for the product launch post is up — https://docs.redwood.ai/launch-post-evie. Asks: pick hero language, drop a one-line benchmark card under hero, finalize webinar CTA + 3-tier reg form and UTMs, plus a short privacy blurb. Quick passes by 2pm PT pls.

matt.prod: Skimmed. Suggest hero: 'Redwood Inference: production LLM serving that can lower per-token inference cost by up to ~40% for common batch/latency profiles.'

jon.content: Move the stat above the fold as a small card: 'Benchmark snapshot: up to ~40% lower per-token cost vs baseline single-instance serving*' then link to appendix footnote. Trim intro paragraph to 2 lines.

tara.legal: Quickpass: use 'can lower' or 'can reduce' + keep 'up to'. Footnote required: '*Benchmarks run on Redwood internal workloads; results vary by model, sequence length, batch size, and config. See appendix for methodology and run dates.' Add privacy note by the form: 'By registering you consent to contact from Redwood; data is stored in HubSpot per our privacy policy.' No competitor names without public citation.

lee.growth: UTMs: ?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=launch_may. Add hidden field 'launch_interest' and select options: [Attend live, Watch recording, Pilot/case-study]. I'll map to HubSpot after we lock the copy. Recommend tag 'launch_may' for routing.

sasha.design: Will create a compact hero stat card + CTA button. Need final CTA text and a 2-line "what you'll learn" for the card. Also will prep mobile sticky.

ejon.content: Draft CTA: 'Register: Live demo + cost playbook'
What you'll learn: - Practical cost levers and benchmark context - Deployment checklist for Dedicated & Private - Live demo + product Q&A

evie.marketing: Pasting final short footnote & privacy copy into the doc. CTA link will include UTMs. If no objections by 2pm PT I'll lock and create the HubSpot form mapping with Lee, and send design the asset request.

notify-bot: Publish window reminder: slot opens in 36 hours. Approvals required before 2pm PT to hit the window.

tara.legal: Approved with footnote + privacy blurb included.

matt.prod: Approved. Tiny nit fixed in the doc.

jon.content: Approved from content side.

sasha.design: Approved on layout; I'll deliver assets by EOD tomorrow.

lee.growth: +1 on UTMs and form fields. Will prep HubSpot mapping after lock.

evie.marketing: Great ":tada:" locking content and kicking handoffs.
